needs.name: Needs & Expectations
needs.description: What is missing? What is required?

truth.name: Fears & Truths
truth.description: The things we are afraid to say

questions.question: What are you hoping I will notice without you having to ask?
Where has something you do for us become so reliable that I barely see it?
What action this week would make support feel tangible?
Which expectation between us has never actually been agreed on?
What need do you soften so much that I can no longer hear it?
Where does effort feel uneven, and what specific moments make it feel that way?
What communication habit of mine makes a difficult subject harder?
When have I misunderstood you and then defended my interpretation?
Which old hurt is still organizing a current reaction?
What change would make one of my apologies more credible?
Which sentence from me still echoes longer than I probably realize?
When do you feel you have to face a problem alone, even when I am present?
Which conflict repeats because we solve the event but not the pattern?
What do I do that makes you feel evaluated rather than known?
Which question are you afraid could change us once it is answered?
What do we both know but keep treating as temporary?
If this relationship ended, which repeated pattern would be most likely to cause it?
Which version of you feels least welcome around me?
What about our future feels alive, and what feels quietly wrong?
Which truth do you withhold because you are already managing my reaction?
What have you stopped hoping I would understand without being told?
